stories.title: Jury dismisses all claims in Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman
stories.summary: A jury in a California courtroom has dismissed all claims in the case Elon Musk brought against Sam Altman and OpenAI.

stories.title: Israeli Navy intercepts activist trying to break Gaza blockade with aid ships
stories.summary: On Monday, the Israeli navy intercepted a flotilla of 54 boats of activists headed to Gaza with humanitarian aid.

stories.title: Drake, in rebuilding mode, goes all in by releasing three albums at once
stories.summary: With his first major solo output since his battle with Kendrick Lamar in 2024 ended, Drake does what Drake has always done: puts out more music than most people could reasonably consume.

stories.title: President Trump drops lawsuit against IRS
stories.summary: President Trump is walking away from a $10 billion case he filed against the IRS. But the resolution of the case is prompting House Democrats and ethics officials to cry foul.

stories.title: The National Weather Service is on a hiring spree ahead of hurricane season
stories.summary: As hurricane season approaches, the National Weather Service is on a hiring spree to make up for cuts it made last year under the DOGE initiative.

stories.title: As Hajj nears, Pakistan pilgrims face uncertainty amid regional conflict
stories.summary: As millions of Muslims prepare for the annual Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca, Pakistan is sending one of the largest groups amid added uncertainty from the war in the Middle East.
